flags.message: Forward-mode retrieval hygiene note: the decisive signal for this cell's below-baseline number (P(disturbed)=0.45 vs the 0.697 pooled merits baseline) is the Solicitor General's CVSG brief endorsing the Eighth Circuit's federal-standard rule — public information predating the snapshot, but sourced from secondary press summaries (the brief PDF itself was not text-extractable with the cell's tooling). If those summaries mischaracterized the SG's merits position, the adjustment is unsupported.
